description: This file contains SwiftUI views and supporting shapes/constants for rendering chat message UI components, including message bubbles (for user and assistant), typing indicators, and tool call results, within a chat application.

classes.name: ChatBubbleShape
classes.description: A custom shape for chat message bubbles that can include a tail pointing left or right, or be plain.

classes.name: ChatMessageBubble
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing a chat message bubble, customizable for user or assistant messages.

classes.name: ChatMessageBody
classes.description: A private SwiftUI View that renders the content inside a message bubble, including text, attachments, tool calls, and results.

classes.name: AttachmentRow
classes.description: A view for displaying an attachment in a chat message.

classes.name: ToolCallCard
classes.description: A view for displaying a tool call within a chat message.

classes.name: ToolResultCard
classes.description: A view for displaying the result of a tool execution within a chat message, with toggle for full/partial display.

classes.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
classes.description: A view indicating that the assistant is typing, with animated dots.

classes.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
classes.description: A view showing ongoing assistant response in streaming mode.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
classes.description: A view indicating that tools are currently running.

classes.name: TypingDots
classes.description: A small animated view representing typing indicator dots.

classes.name: ChatAssistantTextBody
classes.description: A private view for rendering assistant message text with support for markdown segments and thinking indicator.

methods.name: inset(by:)
methods.description: Returns a new ChatBubbleShape inset by the specified amount, for shape outlining effects.

methods.name: path(in:)
methods.description: Generates the Path for the chat bubble shape, including optional tails.

methods.name: rightTailPath(in:radius:)
methods.description: Creates the shape path for a bubble with a right-pointing tail.

methods.name: leftTailPath(in:radius:)
methods.description: Creates the shape path for a bubble with a left-pointing tail.

methods.name: updateAnimationState()
methods.description: Manages animation state for the typing indicator dots based on system animation preferences and scene activity.
